summary: Guard-protected spline evaluation wrapper. If the keyframe array pointer at this[0] is NULL the function returns 0 immediately without side effects. Otherwise it sets the byte flag at this+0x1C to 1 and delegates the actual evaluation to CubicSplineInterpolation, returning its result.

operations.description: Null-pointer guard on the keyframe array pointer at this[0]; when it is NULL return 0 immediately, skipping the flag write and the spline call.
Set the byte flag at this+0x1C to 1 (active/in-use marker) before evaluating.
Call CubicSplineInterpolation(this, a2) to evaluate the keyframe spline at parameter a2.

unresolved: The call target CubicSplineInterpolation is named in the raw source but has no address in the packet; its identity as a distinct function is DERIVED at best.
Semantics of the 0x1C flag (active/in-use marker) beyond being set to 1 before each evaluation.
Interpretation of parameter a2 (spline parameter value) and of the this[0] keyframe array layout.
